input.value: slip and fall on icy walkway, broken wrist

input.rationale: Third-party minor suffered bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to an icy walkway condition, creating clear premises liability exposure.

Injury to a nine-year-old child with a broken wrist (pediatric fracture) qualifies as serious injury; pediatric injuries are treated as high severity even if straightforward treatment is expected, due to potential complications and litigation risk.

input.claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child sustained a broken wrist after slipping on an icy walkway in front of the policyholder's home during an ice storm last week. Parents are pursuing medical bill coverage. High-severity pediatric injury requiring prompt adjuster investigation of premises conditions and potential settlement discussion.
